title: Twelve of Us and One Paper Hat
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：party　|　正文 371 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 party 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: We ① held a party for my grandmother's eightieth in the same room where she had held every party since 1974, and a ② party of twelve arrived on the Saturday, which is what a family becomes when it is counted. She sat at the head and did not stand up once. The ③ party itself was not the point — she had said so for months — but she had also chosen the cake, the music and the hour, and had corrected my mother on all three.

My grandfather, who had been a ④ party member for forty-one years and never once spoke about it at the table, was alive then and sat next to her in a paper hat. I asked him once why he had joined. He said you did not join a ⑤ party in 1952 the way you join a club; you were asked, and the asking was the whole of it, and afterwards there was no leaving.

The only argument of the day was about the house, and it was conducted entirely in the kitchen by my cousin, who is a lawyer and cannot stop. She said that everybody in the room was a ⑥ party to the agreement my grandmother had signed in 2009, that the agreement named no ⑦ other party, and that this was either a kindness or a very serious mistake. My mother said please, not today.

It was a kindness. My grandmother had wanted the ⑧ party to be the thing people remembered about that Saturday, and for eleven hours it was. She had said for months that the party was not the point, and she had also spent eleven months choosing the cake, the music and the hour. At six we took the photograph: twelve of us, one paper hat, and a woman who had got exactly what she wanted.

She died in March. The ⑨ working party that cleared the house found the 2009 agreement in a drawer with the cake recipes, and my cousin, reading it again, said the old woman had known exactly what she was doing. We ⑩ threw a party for her in June, in the same room, with eleven of us, and my cousin said the party was also, technically, a family meeting.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 聚会；宴会；派对
C. n. （合同、诉讼等的）一方；当事人
D. 固定搭配：be (a) party to sth. 参与某事；是……的一方
E. 固定搭配：hold / throw a party 举办聚会
F. 固定搭配：party member 党员
G. n. 一批；一行；一队人（a party of ...）
H. n. （为某项工作派出的）小组；队（a working party）

items.q: held a party for my grandmother's eightieth
a party of twelve arrived on the Saturday
The party itself was not the point
had been a party member for forty-one years
you did not join a party in 1952
was a party to the agreement my grandmother had signed
the agreement named no other party
had wanted the party to be the thing people remembered
The working party that cleared the house
threw a party for her in June

answers.why: hold a party 意为“举办聚会”，指为祖母八十岁办的这场寿宴。
a party of twelve 意为“一行十二人”，指星期六到场的全家人数。
the party itself 指“聚会本身”，说聚会不是重点。
party member 意为“党员”，祖父做了四十一年党员。
join a party 意为“加入一个政党”，1952 年入党不像加入俱乐部。
be party to sth. 意为“是某事的一方、参与某事”，说在场的人都是协议当事方。
the other party 意为“另一方（当事人）”，说协议里没有指明另一方。
the party 指“这场聚会”，祖母希望人们记住的是这场聚会。
a working party 意为“（清理、检修等的）工作小组”，此处指清理房子的一队人。
throw a party 意为“办一场聚会”，六月我们在同一个房间为她办了一次。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我们在同一个房间里为祖母举办了八十岁寿宴。（hold a party）
一行十二人在星期六到达。（a party of）
我祖父做了四十一年党员。（party member）
他说，1952 年入党不像加入俱乐部那样。（join a party）
屋里的每个人都是那份协议的当事方。（be party to）
那份协议没有指明另一方。（the other party）
answers: We held a party for my grandmother's eightieth in the same room.
A party of twelve arrived on the Saturday.
My grandfather had been a party member for forty-one years.
He said you did not join a party in 1952 the way you join a club.
Everybody in the room was a party to the agreement.
The agreement named no other party.
